description: This Dart source file defines the AppDatabase singleton class responsible for managing and opening the SQLite database for an expense tracker app. It includes database initialization, schema creation with tables for categories, transactions, budgets, and meta information.

classes.name: AppDatabase
classes.description: Singleton class providing access to the application's SQLite database, including schema creation.

methods.name: database
methods.description: Getter that returns the singleton database instance, opening the database if not already initialized.

methods.name: _onCreate
methods.description: Callback function to create database tables upon initial database creation.
